detail.longDescription: What business doesn't seem to understand is that a better name for A.I. is not "Super Intelligence," but "Artificial Mediocrity." All it does is provide a guided paste of digested human work it was trained on. It will be no better, and likely worse, than the average. It will add nothing to the work beyond that other than the odd glitch. A human brings their life experience and judgement to the most casual work. That can be bad too, but it can also be BRILLIANT. # AI # artificialintelligence
